entries.Original: When enabled, forces the selected movement mode while auto-running.
entries.Translated: 当启用时，在自动运行时强制使用所选的运动模式。

entries.Original: When enabled, forces the selected movement mode while rotating the camera. This is probably redundant.
entries.Translated: 当启用时，在旋转摄像头时强制使用所选的运动模式。这可能是多余的。

entries.Original: Before using this plugin, I suggest making the following changes to your character config:
entries.Translated: 在使用这个插件之前，我建议对您的角色配置进行以下修改：

entries.Original: - Under Character Configuration -> Legacy Type, toggle the option "Disable camera pivot" on
entries.Translated: - 在角色配置下->旧版类型下，将 “禁用摄像机枢轴” 选项切换为

entries.Original: - Under Character Configuration -> Camera Controls, set the option "Standard Type Camera Auto-adjustment" to "Never", and subsequently disable "Enable Y-axis auto-adjustment"
entries.Translated: 在字符配置下->摄像机控制，将 “标准型摄像机自动调整” 选项设置为 “永不”，然后禁用 “启用 Y 轴自动调整”。

entries.Original: Additionally, you should try using strafe over turn movement, and vice-versa.
entries.Translated: 此外，你还应该尝试在翻转动作上使用压制动作，反之亦然。

entries.Original: This means going into your keybinds and changing your primary movement keys from turn to strafe, and decide which feels the best to use while under the influence of this plugin.
entries.Translated: 这意味着进入您的键盘绑定，将您的主要移动键从 “转” 改为 “击打”，并决定在这个插件的影响下使用哪个键感觉最好。
